highlights.title: Opens on your chats
highlights.text: The Android app shows your chats and newest messages the moment it opens, even offline, with anything that arrived while it was closed already there.

highlights.title: Pull to refresh
highlights.text: Pull down on Chats, Status, Contacts or Settings, or up at the end of a chat, to bring it up to date.

highlights.title: Games, one tap away
highlights.text: A banner takes you back to a game in progress, the leaderboard adds up everyone's wins, and thrown emoji now move.

highlights.title: Someone's typing
highlights.text: A cat peeks over the typing bubble while they write, then ducks back out of sight.

highlights.title: A fresh emoji picker
highlights.text: The newest emoji, your recent ones first and a skin tone for every hand, even offline in the app.

highlights.title: Emoji where the keyboard was
highlights.text: On a phone, emoji open in the keyboard's place and a quick flick shows more. On a computer, they open under the message box.

highlights.title: Reactions in one place
highlights.text: More reactions slides up from below, with your six quick reactions on top to use or change right there.

highlights.title: Microphone beside the plus
highlights.text: Hold it to record a voice note, and slide right to cancel.

highlights.title: Livelier emoji in games
highlights.text: Throw laugh, cry, taunt, kiss, cool, angry, shocked, melt or party from a bigger tray where every face moves.

highlights.title: Jackaroo
highlights.text: A card-and-marble race for two: bring your four marbles home, knock theirs out and jump across the swirls, against a friend or the bot.

highlights.title: Talk at the table
highlights.text: Say something or throw an emoji without leaving a game, and see each player's words beside their seat.

highlights.title: Rules and scores in the game
highlights.text: A game's rules open as pages with pictures, and its leaderboard shows just that game, without leaving it.

highlights.title: Game invites
highlights.text: Opening a game in a chat shows a line there, and in a one-to-one chat it invites the other person, even when Whisprl is closed.

highlights.title: Draw with taps
highlights.text: A tap leaves a dot, two fingers draw a straight line and three fingers draw a circle.

highlights.title: Find games by other names
highlights.text: Search xo or noughts and crosses and Tic-tac-toe turns up.

highlights.title: Save to your phone
highlights.text: Photos, videos and files from a chat can be saved to the Gallery or Downloads in the app.

highlights.title: Quieter alerts
highlights.text: A short note appears only for what you just did, at the bottom on a phone and the top on a computer.

highlights.title: Screens that move like an app
highlights.text: On a phone, a chat or page slides in from the right and slides back out, and the tabs slide sideways in the order of the bar. Computers keep the same layout.

highlights.title: Games start at once
highlights.text: Pick a game and its table opens straight away while the seats are set up, instead of a pause before anything shows.

highlights.title: Smoother chats
highlights.text: Chats and the list show placeholders while they load, so the screen is never blank and never says you have no chats yet.

highlights.title: Games take the whole screen
highlights.text: On a phone, a game fills the screen with nothing above it, and going back brings the chat straight back.

highlights.title: Status from your camera
highlights.text: Take a photo or record a video for your status straight from the New update menu.

highlights.title: Games in your chats
highlights.text: Play Tic-tac-toe, Dots and Boxes or Chain Reaction beside the conversation. Each chat keeps its own leaderboard.

highlights.title: Play the bot
highlights.text: No one around? Play the bot from a game's start screen. Games against it are practice and stay off the leaderboard.

highlights.title: Games in groups
highlights.text: In a group, the owner and admins choose the game, the board and how many play, up to six.

highlights.title: Quick emoji
highlights.text: Tap the emoji beside the message box to send it, or hold to send it bigger. Pick yours, and your six reactions, for each chat from its details panel.

highlights.title: Swipe a status
highlights.text: Swipe down to close a status, or up to reply. On your own update, swipe up to see who has watched.

highlights.title: Report a message
highlights.text: Report a message from its menu. The report includes the messages around it, and the dialog tells you what is sent before it goes.

highlights.title: A new Contacts page
highlights.text: Requests sit above your friends, Find people searches everyone on Whisprl, and a QR code shares your profile.

highlights.title: Requests with a note
highlights.text: Say who you are when you add someone. The note is end-to-end encrypted and opens your chat once they accept.

highlights.title: Birthdays
highlights.text: Friends see the day and month, never the year, with Birthdays this week in Contacts. Hide yours in Settings any time.

highlights.title: Settings in sections
highlights.text: Your profile, appearance, chats, privacy and security each have a page of their own, on a computer and a phone.
